brief:
Wave 2 — one package, one implementer (effort max). Goal: every recovery DECISION moves to RecoveryPolicy; AVPlayerBackend becomes an adapter that emits observations/events and executes actions; the loopback lifecycle glue becomes LocalHLSHost; PlaybackEngineSession owns backend+transport+host per LoadID; PlayerViewModel still orchestrates loads (the reducer/actor cutover is wave 3) but talks ONLY to PlaybackEngineSession and a RecoveryDriver, never to backend ladders or to its own outage/renewal code paths.

STEP 1 (LocalHLSHost). Create Engine/LocalHLSHost.swift per design §2.8 by MOVING startSiloLoopback steps 1–11, startSiloLoopbackWriter's 13 callback wirings, handleFirstSegmentReady's playlist-URL choice (NOT the display-criteria/attach part — that stays in the backend), requestVODProducerRestart + vodRestartCoalescer + base/head indices, vodPlanForCurrentSource/loopbackVODPlan, ensureLoopbackSubtitleTap, the budgets (store memory/spill/VOD retention selection), sessionDirectory + SILO_KEEP_DV_HLS (read once at init — §7.2), and the loopback half of teardownMediaPipeline into the host. Callbacks become `onEvent: (EngineEvent) -> Void` (firstSegmentReady(url), planResolved(plan, anchorSeconds), generatedStats, sourceDownloadStats, bridgedAudioAnchored, hdr10PlusDetected, subtitleTap*, failed(PlaybackFailure)) and `onObservation: (RecoveryObservation) -> Void`. The writer's `playbackPositionProvider` / `isSourceOutageActive` become init closures. The backend keeps `attachLoopbackItem(url:)`, `finishPreparingAssetPlayback`, display criteria, `reloadEstablishedLoopbackItem`, `applyLoopbackItemBufferPolicy`, `issueVODResumePreSeekIfNeeded`, and calls `host.requestProducerRestart` where it used to call requestVODProducerRestart (server miss resolver, performVODStallRecovery). Delete activeLoopbackSessionID / loopbackGeneration — identity is the host instance (one host per LoadID; stale callbacks are dropped because the host is torn down and its closures cleared).
STEP 2 (observations out, actions in). In AVPlayerBackend replace each ladder's DECISION with emission of the RecoveryObservation (startupTick from the 1 Hz startup timer; playheadTick from the 1 Hz playhead timer with the PlayheadSample fields; itemDeathEvidence from errorLog/failedToEnd; edgeSample from the time observer + generated stats; playbackStalled; playlistUnchanged; likelyToKeepUp from the two KVOs; seekDeadlineExpired) and add `func perform(_ action: RecoveryAction)` executing exactly the legacy action bodies (reassertPlay → avPlayer.play(); nudgeStartup → nudgeLoopbackStartupConsumer; reloadStartupItem → reloadLoopbackStartupItem; reanchor → the body of recoverLocalLoopbackStallIfNeeded's action (flushOnSeek, extractor seek, load(reanchored)); reloadItem → reloadEstablishedLoopbackItem; restartProducer → host.requestProducerRestart; rebuildLocalSession → load(reanchored) (budget lives in the policy context now); deferUntilPlay → pendingLocalLoopbackRecoveryMediaTime semantics via a stored `deferredRecoveryMediaTime` consumed by play(); resumePlayback → avPlayer.play(); fail → reportFailure). Delete: the six ladders' decision code, watchdogReanchor*, didEscalateLoopbackStall, lastLocalLoopbackStallRecoveryAt, loopbackItemDeath*State fields (the types stay — the policy context owns instances), loopbackEdgeWatch, loopbackRebuildBudget, setRecoverySuspended/setExternalStallSuppression/kickPlaybackAfterExternalStallCleared (suspension is RecoveryContext.suspendedReasons; the kick becomes `.endOutageRideThrough(kick:)` executed as performVODStallRecovery(attempt:1) under the same guards). Keep the timers as observation sources with the same periods. Keep the telemetry log lines.
STEP 3 (RecoveryDriver). Recovery/RecoveryDriver.swift — `@MainActor final class RecoveryDriver` holding `RecoveryContext`, `func observe(_ o: RecoveryObservation, now: Date) -> RecoveryAction?` calling RecoveryPolicy.decide and storing the new context; `func setSuspended(_ on: Bool, reason: String)`; `func noteUserPaused/playbackEstablished/route`. The engine session owns one per LoadID and routes backend/host/proxy observations through it; loopback in-route actions are performed by the backend/host immediately; VM-level actions (treatAsNaturalEnd, requestServerReplan, renew*, rideThroughOutage/endOutageRideThrough, recoverFromServerOutage/waitForServerReady, autoRecoverInterruption, switchRoute, fail) are delivered to the VM via ONE closure `onControlAction: (RecoveryAction, LoadID) -> Void`, and the VM's existing functions execute them (attemptProtocolV3Replan, attemptBackgroundSessionRenewal, attemptStaleSessionRenewal, the outage ride-through task, attemptServerOutageRecovery, triggerAutomaticInterruptionRecovery, makeLoopbackFallbackPlan/requestServerHLSRouteFallback, finalizeTerminalPlaybackError) — their DECISION preambles (rung order, latches, thresholds) are deleted from the VM because the policy made the decision; their EXECUTION bodies stay until wave 3.
STEP 4 (PlaybackEngineSession). Engine/PlaybackEngineSession.swift per design §2.8: `init(loadID:plan:backendFactory:reusing:)` (reusing non-nil ⇒ adopt the existing backend instance — the tvOS in-place replan path, I4), `start(startSeconds:)` (builds LocalHLSHost for .localHLS, prepares the source proxy via the moved prepareSourceProxy logic, calls backend.load*), `events: AsyncStream<EngineEvent>` (the 17 callbacks translated; the engine session binds them ONCE per session — the VM no longer re-wires closures per load), `surfaceBackend`, `retargetSource`, `seek(SeekRequest)` (the backend's seek + deadline), `perform(RecoveryAction)`, `dispose(reason:)` (host teardown + backend dispose + proxy stop). Move prepareSourceProxy/stash/discard/adopt cache handoff (PVM:2907-3070) into the engine session (the cache handoff across sessions becomes a static `SourceCacheHandoff` passed to the next session's init).
STEP 5 (VM retarget). PlayerViewModel: `avPlayerBackend` becomes `engineSession?.surfaceBackend` (views still read `viewModel.avPlayerBackend`); loadStream → builds/reuses `PlaybackEngineSession` and consumes `events` in ONE registered task per LoadID (replacing makeCallbacks/applyCallbacks/wireSubtitleCallbacks and the by-value generation guards in them — the stream ends when the session is disposed, which IS the staleness guard; keep `streamLoadGeneration` only if some non-callback site still needs it and say which); installBackend/prepareBackend/loadBackend/reapplyUserGain fold into the session; handlePlaybackError's ladder → `driver.observe(.engineFailed(f))`; proxy callbacks → observations; handleOriginOutageChanged/noteBufferingDuringSourceOutage/clearSourceOutageRideThroughState decision parts → policy; `hasAttemptedNativeDirectRouteRecovery/hasAttemptedSiloRouteHLSFallback` → context flags. Track coordinator ports: `backend` now returns `engineSession?.backend`.
STEP 6 (tests). PlaybackEngineSessionTests (FakePlaybackBackend: start/dispose/reuse keeps the instance; events stamped; perform maps actions → calls), LocalHLSHostTests (teardown nils everything, session dir removed unless keep; coalescer; playlist URL choice), RecoveryDriverTests (suspension → nil; context threading). Full suite 1539 + wave-1 tests + these. Build all three schemes.
STEP 7 (greps the reviewer runs): `activeLoopbackSessionID`, `loopbackGeneration`, `setExternalStallSuppression`, `kickPlaybackAfterExternalStallCleared`, `setRecoverySuspended`, `watchdogReanchorCount`, `didEscalateLoopbackStall`, `loopbackRebuildBudget` (field), `startSiloLoopback(`, `requestVODProducerRestart(` (outside LocalHLSHost), `makeCallbacks(`, `applyCallbacks(` → zero hits in iosApp/.
